description: Delaware Homeowners Handbook to Prepare for Natural Hazards is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Delaware Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control; Delaware Emergency Management Agency; Delaware Sea Grant. Download this handy guide that covers everything from common myths about natural hazards to protecting your property with insurance, as well as adapting to the impacts of climate change. Tens of major storms have threatened Delaware’s coast over the past three decades, putting lives and property at risk. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, High Winds. Assets: Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
